_comment_presets: Add your own document presets here. They appear in the TUI preset picker and in detection. Copy the 'wis' example.

wis.label: Mercedes WIS service docs
wis.description: DaimlerChrysler WIS print-outs; each page has a document code and a heading.
wis.vision_prompt:
You are given ONE Mercedes-Benz WIS (Workshop Information System) print-out page.

Read the document code on the page (format XX00.00-P-0000Z or XX00.00-Z-0000ZZ, usually the top line), the printed heading/title, the models it applies to, and the document's own date (DD.MM.YY, e.g. 12.8.92). Ignore the "Copyright DaimlerChrysler AG <date>" and "CD-Ausgabe G/09/05" print-metadata lines; "G/09/05" is the catalog edition, NOT the document code. A document code always contains a hyphen and looks like XX00.00-P-0000Z (or XX00.00-Z-0000ZZ).

Return ONLY JSON:
{
  "doc_code": "the WIS code, or \"\" if none is printed",
  "title": "the printed heading/title",
  "models": "the model list, or \"all\"",
  "date": "the document date, or \"\"",
  "family": "WS | SI | OS | AD | AH | AS | other",
  "doc_type": "service-document",
  "confidence": 0.0,
  "needs_human": false,
  "notes": ""
}

If no code is printed, set "doc_code" to "" and put the heading in "title".
If the heading is unreadable, set "needs_human": true.
Output JSON only.
